slides.label: Hero
slides.eyebrow: Recipe keeper · meal planner · shopping list
slides.headline:
Your recipes.
One calm place.
slides.alt: Recipe library full of saved recipes

slides.label: Import from a link
slides.headline: Paste a link. Get the recipe.
slides.sub: Ingredients, steps, times, servings and photo, without the ads or the life story.
slides.foot: Most food blogs and recipe sites import in one step

slides.label: Bulk import
slides.headline: 100 links at once.
slides.sub: Moving from bookmarks or Pinterest? Paste them all and watch them land.
slides.foot: Pages without a full recipe card are tagged to review

slides.label: Which sites work
slides.headline: 20 tested sites, and a plan B.
slides.sub: See which sites import by link, and the quick paste step for the few that block it.
slides.foot: Check any website before you rely on it

slides.label: Recipe page
slides.headline: Clean, calm, cookable.
slides.sub: Times, servings, favorites and a plan button, on one tidy page.
slides.foot: Print any recipe as a clean card

slides.label: Servings & units
slides.headline: Cooking for six? Done.
slides.sub: Change the servings and every amount scales. Switch between US and metric.
slides.foot: Copy the ingredients as clean text

slides.label: Cook mode
slides.headline: One step at a time.
slides.sub: Big type and built-in timers. Tap or use the arrow keys to move on.
slides.foot: The ingredients stay one tap away

slides.label: Library
slides.headline: Find it in seconds.
slides.sub: Search, filter by category, tag, collection or time, and edit many at once.
slides.foot: Every recipe saved from a link

slides.label: Meal plan
slides.headline: Plan the week in minutes.
slides.sub: Drag meals between days, Fill my week, or Copy last week.
slides.foot: Servings per meal scale the shopping list

slides.label: Shopping list
slides.headline: Shop by aisle.
slides.sub: One tap sends the week’s ingredients, merged and sorted by aisle.

slides.label: Pantry
slides.headline: What can I cook tonight?
slides.sub: Tell it what you have. See what you can make now, or with a few things more.
slides.foot: Pantry items stay off your shopping list

slides.label: Cook log
slides.headline: Remember how it went.
slides.sub: Rate each recipe and keep a note every time you make it.
slides.foot: Your tweaks, saved for next time

slides.label: Collections
slides.headline: Group it your way.
slides.sub: Weeknight dinners, Sunday baking, family classics. Any collection becomes a book.
slides.foot: Recipes can sit in as many collections as you like

slides.label: Recipe book
slides.headline: A recipe book, made by you.
slides.sub: A designer cover, a contents page and every recipe, ready to print or save as PDF.
slides.foot: Letter or A4 · recipe cards, lists and meal plans too

slides.label: Kitchen insights
slides.headline: See what you really cook.
slides.sub: Most-made recipes, what’s still to try and meals planned this week.

slides.label: Settings & backup
slides.headline: Saved on your device.
slides.sub: Backups that merge without duplicates, a backup folder and CSV export.
